status_summary: No VA action separating the two offices was found since 2025-01-20. The Federal Register search for VA reorganization notices returned none. VA's announced reorganization concerns the Veterans Health Administration, including a proposal reported on 2026-01-28 to cut Veterans Integrated Service Networks from 18 to 5, and the Secretary's written testimony of 2026-02-11 did not mention changes to the human resources and administration office.
